traditional: 喺 A 頂裝上 B
jyutping: hai2 A deng2 zong1 soeng6 B

english.note: Use this for fitting a pointed head or cap onto the top of an object.

examples.english: Put a cap on the tip of the pencil so it will not poke anyone.
examples.traditional: 喺支鉛筆頂裝上個膠帽，就唔會拮親人。
examples.jyutping: hai2 zi1 jyun4 bat1 deng2 zong1 soeng6 go3 gaau1 mou6 zau6 m4 wui5 gat1 can1 jan4
